approval_basis: One actual affirmative reply to the preceding six recommended CC01-CC06 choices. Context establishes collective approval; this is not six separate human approval messages.

approved_choices.CC01: Separate inventory, known-unit accounting, eligible-ready context coverage and whole-request support.
approved_choices.CC02: Expose information-unit denominators, retain all known positive units globally and retain budget-rejected eligible units in eligible-ready coverage.
approved_choices.CC03: Keep partial service and distinct diagnostic states without suppressing independently supported units or relaxing scope/quarantine.
approved_choices.CC04: Avoid 0/0 success and distinguish not applicable, not assessed, incomplete inventory and execution/integrity errors.
approved_choices.CC05: Version new semantics separately; preserve v01/v02 code, locks, actual decisions, references and official scores.
approved_choices.CC06: Evaluate correct handling separately from full answerability; retain exact intent, diagnostics, provenance and resource gates.

implementation_details_status: Machine encoding to be specified separately; no claim that subsequently authored schema/examples were individually reviewed.
